name: rust-security-auditor-codex
description: Example Codex Skill / MCP configuration for using the local Rust Security Auditor from a Codex project context.

recommendedInvocations: @Rust Security Auditor audit project before release
@Rust Security Auditor check this Rust project before commit
@Rust Security Auditor check this Rust project before release
@Rust Security Auditor review accepted risk inventory before release

tools.name: rust_review_current_diff
naturalLanguageEntries: check this Rust project before commit
tools.recommendedUsage: Use before commit, before PR, after agent-generated code, or after touching unsafe/dependencies/build.rs. Returns reviewDecision, suppressionSummary, and suggestedFixPrompt values without modifying code or adding suppressions.

tools.name: rust_audit_unsafe
tools.recommendedUsage: Use for unsafe blocks, unsafe fn, FFI, raw pointers, MaybeUninit, transmute, raw-parts APIs, and unsafe Send/Sync review.

tools.name: rust_audit_dependencies
tools.recommendedUsage: Use for Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, build.rs, git/path dependencies, proc macros, and build dependencies.

tools.name: rust_audit_project
naturalLanguageEntries: check this Rust project before release
tools.recommendedUsage: Use before release or for a full local Rust project security scan.

tools.name: rust_list_accepted_risks
naturalLanguageEntries: review accepted risk inventory before release
tools.recommendedUsage: Use to inventory accepted-risk suppression comments before release or security re-review without running the full scanner or modifying code.

stdioNotes: Use npm --silent run mcp. Plain npm run mcp can print npm lifecycle banners to stdout.
MCP stdio stdout must contain only JSON-RPC protocol frames. Ordinary logs must not pollute stdout.
The server scans local project paths passed by Codex. It does not require uploading code packages.
boundaries: This is not a ChatGPT App configuration.
This is not a SaaS upload flow.
This is not a web UI.
